name: Once-More Scattered Next Event Estimation
definition: A Monte Carlo estimator for volume rendering that samples a scattering vertex $\mathbf{x}_1$ between a shading point $\mathbf{x}_0$ and a light source $\mathbf{x}_2$ to efficiently capture forward-scattering glow effects in thin, homogeneous media.
summary: Once-More Scattered Next Event Estimation is a Monte Carlo technique that improves direct lighting in participating media by inserting an additional scattering vertex to reduce variance in forward-scattering scenarios.
